items.source: Returns the "parameters" condition of this RequestMappingInfo; or instance with 0 parameter expressions, never null.
items.translation: 返回此RequestMappingInfo的"parameters"条件；或具有 0 个参数表达式的实例，永远不会为null。

items.source:
Returns a new instance with the union of the param expressions
from "this" and the "other" instance.
items.translation: 返回一个新实例，该实例包含来自"this"和"other"实例的参数字符串表达式的并集。

items.source: Uses of ParamsRequestCondition in org.springframework.web.reactive.result.condition
Uses of ParamsRequestCondition in org.springframework.web.reactive.result.method
A logical conjunction (' && ') request condition that matches a request against a set parameter expressions with syntax defined in RequestMapping.params().
items.translation: 逻辑与（`' && '`）请求条件，用于根据在RequestMapping.params()中定义的语法将请求与一组参数表达式进行匹配。

items.source: RequestCondition and implementations for matching requests based on different criteria.
items.translation: RequestCondition以及用于根据不同标准匹配请求的实现。

items.source: Returns "this" instance if the request matches all param expressions; or null otherwise.
items.translation: 如果请求匹配所有参数表达式，则返回 "this" 实例；否则返回 null。
处理器方法处理的底层架构。

items.source: Compare to another condition based on parameter expressions.
items.translation: 根据参数表达式比较另一个条件。
